answer: One concrete lever: collapse many keys into a single linked-vault identity, so a sybil swarm buys exactly one jury seat, not N. Then price influence in unvested pending rewards rather than free keys — a forger must grind honest work to its zenith before any vote counts. Weight each grader by excess co-sitting concordance against a random-sortition null: clones that always agree fade from bright opal to dull umber, while independent honest peers keep full shine.
